clusters.title: Level of consciousness
clusters.description: Bedside measures of responsiveness and their outcome counterparts.

clusters.title: SAH grading
clusters.description: Clinical grades (Hunt & Hess, WFNS) and CT grades (Fisher, Modified Fisher) are usually reported together.

clusters.title: Spinal metastases
clusters.description: Stability (SINS), prognosis (Tokuhashi, Tomita) and performance status (KPS, ECOG) inform multidisciplinary decisions together.

clusters.title: Acute stroke assessment
clusters.description: Clinical deficit (NIHSS), early CT change (ASPECTS) and pre-morbid / outcome function (mRS).

clusters.title: Prehospital LVO screens
clusters.description: Brief scales to estimate large vessel occlusion likelihood before imaging.

clusters.title: Transient ischaemic attack
clusters.description: Early risk after TIA and assessment of any persisting deficit.

clusters.title: Intracerebral haemorrhage
clusters.description: Severity (ICH Score), expected function (FUNC) and ventricular blood (Graeb).

clusters.title: Trauma severity
clusters.description: Physiological (RTS) and anatomical (ISS) severity, combined in TRISS.

clusters.title: Functional outcome
clusters.description: Global outcome scales used at follow-up.

clusters.title: Cervical myelopathy
clusters.description: Walking-based (Nurick) and broader functional (mJOA) myelopathy scores.

clusters.title: Neurocritical care
clusters.description: Arousal, coma and organ-dysfunction measures used in the ICU.

clusters.title: Motor and reflex examination
clusters.description: Bedside grades for strength, reflexes and upper motor neuron signs.

clusters.title: Spasticity
clusters.description: Resistance to passive movement, its velocity-dependent component, and clonus.

clusters.title: Cerebellopontine angle
clusters.description: Facial nerve and hearing grades used before and after CPA surgery or radiosurgery.

clusters.title: Vascular malformations
clusters.description: Brain AVM grades and dural arteriovenous fistula classifications.

clusters.title: Epilepsy surgery outcome
clusters.description: Seizure outcome classifications after epilepsy surgery.
